## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run gate` is green on my machine.
- [ ] A change in behaviour comes with a test that failed before the change.
- [ ] New dependencies and assets are under an allowed licence and listed in `ATTRIBUTION.md`
      (or there are none).
- [ ] No analytics, cookies, outside fonts, scripts or requests to other servers.

### For lessons and translations

- [ ] Every site language has the lesson (`ru.md` is the base), or I say below which one is
      missing and ask for help.
- [ ] My own words; nothing copied or closely retold from closed resources.
- [ ] Facts come from the sources listed in the lesson; CWE, CVE and ATT&CK numbers match MITRE
      and NVD.
- [ ] A made-up system with teaching addresses only; no ready-to-run exploit.
- [ ] I opened the lesson in the browser (`npm run dev`) with the defence off and on.

By sending this pull request I agree that code is published under MIT and lesson texts and
diagrams under CC BY-SA 4.0.
